items.date: rates unchanged in the 2017–2024 tables; no 2026 change found
items.notes: TAX life, not economic life: degressive method allowed (coefficient up to 2.0 for group 3–6 in the first years), and individual/one-off depreciation regimes exist. The UK book uses 13 yr (German AfA table) as its economic-life proxy; Polish tax life is ~half. The KŚT code mapping (rodzaj 41 v 403) was not read off the Act itself. items.basis: 2026 Polish full-time calendar: 251 working days / 2,008 h (Labour Code art. 130: 40 h × weeks + 8 h × remaining weekdays − 8 h per holiday falling Mon–Sat; Saturday holidays 15 Aug and 26 Dec give a day off). 251 × 24 h = 6,024 h. Plant-day basis (Mon–Fri less the 8 weekday holidays: 261 − 8 = 253 days, Ordio) gives 253 × 24 = 6,072 h
items.notes: Weekday holidays 2026 (my count from the statutory list): 1 Jan, 6 Jan, 6 Apr (Easter Mon), 1 May, 4 Jun (Corpus Christi), 11 Nov, 24 Dec (holiday from 2025), 25 Dec = 8; 261 weekdays − 8 = 253; − 2 days off for Saturday holidays = 251 (matches the sources). These are calendar hours before downtime/utilisation. Book CNC rows use 4,000 h × 0.8.
